mentions.name: Ukulele songbook (ChordPro-generated PDFs)
mentions.description: This project creates songbooks for the author's favourite songs, compiled from text files into polished PDFs using the ChordPro CLI tool (works for ukulele as well as guitar or piano), with front matter produced via pandoc and LaTeX; the current songbook is a gift for friends.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been making songbooks for my favourite songs. I am currently working on a songbook for some friends. I've found https://www.chordpro.org/ an amazing CLI tool, under active development. I am using the ukulele, but the program also easily can do guitar or piano. The program reads a bunch of text files and produces a really nice PDF.
